title: Hosted API phased safety fencer and incremental traffic switch
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Our hosted API regional rollouts and blue/green swaps currently rely on coarse-weighted traffic shifts and manual holdpoints. Recent minor regressions required full rollback and increased incident MTTR. Goal: Implement a phased safety fencer that enforces SLO-driven holdpoints and incremental traffic switching per-region and per-tenant with automated rapid-cutover and quarantine on anomaly detection. The feature should integrate with existing rollout controller, Console dashboards, and rollout policy definitions. This ticket covers design, control-plane implementation, a safety library consumed by the orchestrator, and end-to-end tests in canary envs.
acceptance_criteria: Controller can perform incremental traffic shifts with configurable step size and step interval per region
SLO-based holdpoints halt progression automatically when latency/error thresholds breach and emit clear reason codes
Automatic fallback to previous stable variant and tenant-level quarantine when persistent degradation is detected
New safety fencer exposes observability: per-step metrics, trace IDs, decision events, and a Console view for in-flight rollouts
E2E tests simulate step regressions and verify automated rollback within SLA for test tenants
No host-level downtime during standard blue/green swap in staging and canary environments
implementation_steps: Design: finalize safety fencer state machine and decision rules (conservative -> permissive)
API: add rolloutPolicy.trafficSteps and rolloutPolicy.sloChecks to control plane schema
Controller: implement phased-fence module with step executor, timeout, and anomaly detector hook
Integrations: wire safety events into Console event stream and tracing pipeline
Telemetry: emit per-step metrics (step_attempt, step_success, step_fail_reason, latency_p90_delta, error_rate_delta)
Testing: unit tests, integration tests in canary cluster, chaos tests to verify quarantine behavior
Docs: update deployment runbook, Console rollout UX, and API docs
Rollout: deploy to canary -> staging -> regional pilot with manual guardrails before global enable
